steps.title: Distance check
steps.say: Yes — in early July, Earth is at its farthest point from the Sun, yet the Northern Hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun, so sunlight is more concentrated and days are longer.

ops.text:
Yes! In early July Earth is farthest
from the Sun, but distance is not
the main cause.

steps.title: Direct vs slanted sunlight
steps.say: Compare the same beam of sunlight: when it hits straight on, the energy is packed into a smaller spot; when it hits at a slant, the same energy spreads out.
